message.content: {"note_claim": "Russian officials often deny the existence of ghettos, but independent analyses identify emerging ethnic enclaves (ghettos) in Moscow.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Since 1991, Moscow officials have insisted that there are no ghettos in the Russian Federation.", "reason": "The page substantiates that officials deny ghettos and that ethnic enclaves exist across Russia, but it does not name Kapotnya, Golyanovo, or Nekrasovka or identify specific Moscow areas."}

parsed.note_claim: Russian officials often deny the existence of ghettos, but independent analyses identify emerging ethnic enclaves (ghettos) in Moscow.
